image_intervention: Upper-agent RGB only. Every request still renders and saves current RGB; frozen arm sends exact first frame. Numeric pose feedback and action history stay current. Six-call maximum and trigger rules unchanged. Actual calls, tokens and latency reported; not an equal-compute claim.
inference: Two primary exact paired two-sided McNemar comparisons, Holm across the two primary tests; unadjusted values also shown. Full vs continue is a declared secondary comparison. Report paired effect sizes, per-seed rates, Wilson intervals, drops, duration, actual calls/tokens/delays. No outcome-based stopping or checkpoint selection.
exclusions: Symmetric service eligibility across the three confirmation arms, and separately across the two image arms. Retain every raw visited slot, stop on service errors; resume only unvisited slots after audited segment registration.
stopping: Finish all registered slots, audit both studies, then stop. No automatic additional training or experiments.
success_definition: Autonomous stop at the correctly bound requested semantic target, full quaternion error <=0.16 rad, no previous drop. Reaching alone is not completion. No extra hold requirement.
note: Cohorts above define the new seeds. Historical seed fields embedded in the parent are not the current cohort.
